svg.title: Abdulqudus Aremu, backend engineer
svg.desc: Senior Software Engineer at Seamfix, based in Lagos. I build backend systems that stay correct when things fail. An engraved portrait, a list of systems and writing, and a figure of checkpoint recovery: worker A completes two steps and is lost on the third, and worker B resumes at step three.
svg.text: A job that survives its worker
From raw feedback to a ranked list of problems
Connectors that survive other people’s APIs
My code comments are not for humans anymore
